title: 年入$160万 plateau 了，她如何突破？

author: 阿星
content:
﻿# 年入$160万 plateau 了，她如何突破？

## 冷启动：10年做到$1000万 lifetime sales

Katie 2010年和 husband 共同创立 Barn2。

Because she wanted to work for herself。

Have flexible lifestyle。

Instead of rigid 9-to-5 office routine。

Building websites for clients met that aim。

但她 wanted more。

Even-better lifestyle that selling software products promised。

他们开始是 WordPress-focused web design agency。

2016年 transitioned to WordPress plugins。

虽然 selling、maintaining、supporting plugins 是 lot of work。

Much more scalable than client services。

She has never looked back。

Work hard，but only work about 30 hours per week。

Sometimes evenings and weekends。

Other times days off with family or friends。

Works both ways，flexibility is key。

Husband 2024年 stepped back。

Now she's running it alone with team of 15。

Work remotely from various countries worldwide。

现在有 suite of 19 premium WordPress and WooCommerce plugins。

还有 Shopify app 叫 Barn2 Bundles & Bulk Discounts。

More Shopify apps on way。

2026年3月，reached $10 million in lifetime plugin sales。

庆祝了 first plugin's launch 10-year anniversary。

产品 currently bring in $1.6 million/year。

## 反直觉：AI让他们 plateau，但也给了新机会

Revenue grew steadily until mid-2024。

Since then，revenue stable overall。

But growth in annual renewals driving that stability。

New sales revenue declining。

She believes reason is two-fold：

1. More people vibe coding own solutions instead of using simpler utility plugins。
2. Changes in how people discover plugins。

They've always generated most sales through organic SEO and Google。

Took big hit after Google introduced AI overviews。

People started using AI chat for website solutions。

Even when AI recommends their plugins。

Generates far fewer sales than if found through Google。

Probably because don't see them as only solution。

Nor see professional branding、calls to action、newsletter signups。

If started over，would build much bigger products。

Provide essential solutions。

Become fundamental part of customers' workflow。

Lot of current products are simple utility plugins。

Add specific features to WordPress or WooCommerce。

While useful，category threatened by AI。

Now planning Barn2's next steps：

Branching into other marketing methods。

Considering which software product categories most future-proof。

Perfecting and expanding biggest and most successful WordPress products。

Diversification into Shopify is another key tactic。

Shopify apps appear less threatened by AI than WordPress plugins。

Particularly because nearly everyone finds apps on Shopify's App Store rather than via Google。

Completely changes discovery。

Shopify is best chance at breaking through plateau。

## 暴击：她用Claude写了个内部工具，比买的好用

In this role，her tech stack centers on ClickUp。

Project management、time tracking、team chat。

Also heavy Claude user。

Few months ago，started using it to develop internal tools。

例如 tool for creating better sales reports。

Amazed by results。

Now have better reports than ever had！

Also use Wispr Flow instead of typing。

Types incredibly fast at 90 words per minute。

But with Wispr Flow，can dictate at 160 words per minute。

Vastly improving productivity。

Big fan of Google Drive Suite。

Google Docs、Google Sheets for company documents。

As WordPress company，WordPress is core part of tech stack。

All public-facing websites and product demos。

Also internal company wiki — private WordPress site。

Main site uses Easy Digital Downloads to sell plugins。

##  punchline：成为AI-native公司

Here's her advice to indie hackers just starting out。

Differs significantly from how she built Barn2！

**First，be AI-native company。**

Hire as few people as possible。

Deeply incorporate AI into all workflows to keep operations lean and profitable。

It's not about specific tasks。

Consider every task business will require and how to use AI for greater efficiency。

Ground-up approach，not something to add in later。

If have established business，reaching that point very difficult。

Because AI may not be able to optimize existing processes。

But if just starting out，presents incredible opportunity。

**Second，when choosing products，look for most future-proof ideas possible。**

Recommend identifying major problem can solve for specific group of people。

Don't think about what platform build it on。

Instead，approach by providing solution for these people。

Rest will naturally evolve。
